text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwean workers reported to work as usual on Tuesday despite a call by the Zimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions (ZCTU) for a nation-wide strike to press government to resolve the health crisis in the country.

- The Zimbabwe national army on Tuesday deployed 10 cadet doctors to Harare hospital to ease an acute medical staff shortage caused by a three-week-old strike by junior doctors and nurses demanding better salaries and working conditions.
